motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Eldridge to approve consent items 3A through 3G, with item 3-C amended to reflect a principal amount of $7,355,000.

Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Havlick, to: 1) support continuation of the IPM program for parks; 2) Recommend a study session in August or September to review the draft IPM plan for Parks, Best Management Practices and Maintenance Standards; and 3) Endorsing a continuation of the City Council moratorium on ground spraying in Civic enter Park ad the 50 ft. buffer around waterways until the study session in August or September and expanding the moratorium to include aerial spraying of trees in Civic Center park and within the waterway buffer, except with EPA Toxicity Category IV compounds.
Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Riggle, to amend the motion to allow treatment in the creek corridors with established IPM criteria for pest management of noxious weeds.
Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Havlick to have all councilmembers receive copies of all comments for evaluation of Council employees with anonimity of reviewers being preserved.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 4:4, with Eldridge, Riggle, Ruzzin and Toor dissenting, Corson Absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Eldridge to adopt Emergency Ordinance No. 7215 amending Sections 11-1-49, “Water Conservation Measures,” 11-1-50, “Special Permits,” and 11-1-51, “Enforcement,” B.R.C. 1981, to set forth measures for water conservation purposes, including restrictions on water use, and setting forth details in relation thereto as amended by staff.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0 as amended; Corson and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Poinsatte moved, seconded by Havlick to direct staff to investigate a possible ordinance regarding water block rate increases and bring back for the July 9, 2002 Council meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:1, Corson and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Mock to suspend the rules and continue the Council Meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:1, Corson and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Eldridge to adopt Emergency Ordinance No. 7208 granting permission to Western Disposal Company to operate a yard waste organic material composting program for two years at a property that is located on 63 rd Street between the Boulder County Recycling Center and Stazio ball fields. Applicant: City of Boulder/Western Disposal Inc.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:0; Corson, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick authorizing and directing the disposition of a 2.23 acre parcel of land now used as the Foothills Park and Ride located at Foothills Parkway and Pearl Parkway with final disposition coming back to Council.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:1; Corson and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 11:30 P.M.
